title: Never buy a crochet/knit blanket
text: Never buy a crochet/knit blanket. This was a great blanket for a couple months. Now it’s looking raggedy from my dog’s nails getting caught in it and now my bra hook. I am never buying a crocheted/knit blanket ever again. It’s really frustrating with all the different spots that have come undone
